title: Prescreening Protocol to Enroll in Food Allergy Clinical Studies at a Single Site
official: Prescreening Protocol to Enroll in Food Allergy Clinical Studies at a Single Site
summary: This is a protocol for prescreening of participants who would like to be in clinical studies in our Center at Stanford.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any individual with possible food allergy (as per their clinical history) who is interested in performing the gold standard food challenge for diagnosis.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any individual who does not consent
* Any individual who is currently taking oral steroids
* Any individual with moderate to severe asthma (FEV1\<80%)

sites.f: The Sean N. Parker Center for Allergy and Asthma Research, Stanford University
